Resident of Śrīraṅgam; worshiped Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa deity.

Of the Śrī-sampradāya, at Śrīraṅgam; Lord Caitanya stayed four months in his house (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Madhya 9.82-86). First a worshipper of Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa, after the Lord's company he worshipped Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa (Madhya 9.158-159). Brother of Trimalla Bhaṭṭa and Prabodhānanda Sarasvatī; father of Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī. The record «Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa (Vyeṅkaṭa)» #1758 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

A devout brāhmaṇa and renunciant of Navadvīpa: Nityānanda Prabhu and others lived in his temple, and the dacoits who came to rob Nityānanda's ornaments were delivered there (Caitanya-bhāgavata Antya 5.535-703); in his house the child Gaura ate the Ekādaśī offering (Caitanya-bhāgavata Ādi). The record «Hiraṇya Ṭhākura (of Navadvīpa)» #500 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).

Brother of Veṅkaṭa Bhaṭṭa of Śrī Raṅgam; uncle and guru of Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī; lived in Vṛndāvana (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna). Growse ascribed the Rādhā-rasa-sudhānidhi to Hita Harivaṁśa; the Abhidhāna gives it to Prabodhānanda.

In Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Tuṅgavidyā (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 163).

Not Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī of Kāśī, who has his own record (Whisper, 06-11-2026: two persons; the Gauḍīya Maṭha holds they were one).

Born at Śrīraṅgam; once a Māyāvādī sannyāsī, by Lord Caitanya's mercy he became absorbed in the rāsa of Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. The record «Prabodhānanda Sarasvatī» #1112 was joined to this one (07-11-2026).
